### Load environment

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

### Load data

```{r}
data_dir <- here("data")
augment_df <- readr::read_tsv(file = file.path(data_dir,
                                               "02_dat_clean.tsv.gz"),
                              col_names = TRUE,
                              show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
exons <- readr::read_tsv(gtf_path,
  comment = "#",
  col_names = c("chr",
                "source",
                "feature",
                "start",
                "end",
                "score",
                "strand",
                "frame",
                "attr"),
  col_types = "cccddcccc") |>
  filter(feature == "exon") |>
  mutate(gene_id = str_extract(attr,
                               '(?<=gene_id ")[^"]+'))

# the regex in mutate() allows us to extract the gene ID
# group exons by gene ID and arrange it so it's sorted (necessary for next step)
# mutate the dataframe by collecting the gene lengths
# this is done by finding "start" and "end" for each
# the gtf contains multiple isoforms and they can have overlapping
# transcripts, so we have to account for this and not sum the overlapping bases
# so we make a union of sorts
# the data frame gets an extra column that contains TRUE/FALSE values 
# (what we get from: start>lag(...)) overlaps will return false, which
# helps us keep track of overlaps. default is set to -inf so the new_block
# is always created
# then take the cumsum() of the block and group it by geneid, chr etc...
# then use summarise() to create new columns with block start and end
# drop the groups from previous step here
# then use mutate again to find the block length for each start/end
# and take the sum of these to find the gene length. phew

gene_lengths <- exons |>
  arrange(gene_id,
          chr,
          strand,
          start,
          end) |>
  group_by(gene_id,
           chr,
           strand) |>
  mutate(new_block = start > lag(cummax(end),
                                 default = -Inf),
         block_id = cumsum(new_block)) |>
  group_by(gene_id,
           chr,
           strand,
           block_id) |>
  summarise(block_start = min(start),
    block_end = max(end),
    .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(block_length = block_end - block_start + 1) |>
  group_by(gene_id) |>
  summarise(gene_length = sum(block_length),
            .groups = "drop")

```

#### Convert to count matrix with samples as columns

```{r}
count_matrix <- df |> 
  select(file, gene_id, unstranded) |> 
  filter(str_starts(gene_id, "ENS")) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = file,
              values_from = unstranded) |> 
  rename_with(.cols = starts_with("../data/"),
              .fn = ~ str_split_i(string = .x,
                                  pattern = "/",
                                  i = -2))
head(count_matrix)
```

```{r}
augment_df_wider <- augment_df |>
  select(sample_id, gene_id, unstranded) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_id,
              values_from = unstranded)
```
